research_question: How do exact pointer relay, full-map exchange, and parity-assisted final-round skipping trade aggregate payload bits against interaction turns under bilateral answer output?
scope: Model-free analytic oracle controls only. No stochastic performance estimates, LLM claims, or deployed transport measurements.

task.output_requirement: Both agents independently compute and submit the same exact answer.

pointer_relay.schedule: k sequential one-way messages, alternating sender, one pointer per message
pointer_relay.payload_code: fixed-width binary offset, ceil(log2(n)) ASCII bits

full_map_simultaneous.schedule: one synchronous batch with one directed message from each agent to the other
full_map_simultaneous.payload_code: all n map values as fixed-width binary offsets, ceil(log2(n)) ASCII bits each
full_map_simultaneous.success: zero error after each agent receives the other complete map; both then calculate locally
full_map_simultaneous.turns: one simultaneous batch; not a sequential-speaker round count

parity_assisted_skip_final_pointer.schedule: For k >= 3, Alice sends her n-bit function-parity table with p1; Bob sends his n-bit function-parity table with p2; alternate pointers through p_(k-1). Both use the shared parity table of the final map owner to compute parity(p_k).
parity_assisted_skip_final_pointer.round_convention: k-1 sequential speaker turns, Alice first; one directed message per turn
parity_assisted_skip_final_pointer.payload_code: n parity bits per function plus k-1 fixed-width pointer offsets of ceil(log2(n)) ASCII bits
parity_assisted_skip_final_pointer.source_relation: Explicit deterministic schedule instantiating the parity-table / skip-final-round idea noted by Mao, Yang, and Zhang (ITCS 2025). The reported paper paragraph gives an O(n) protocol for its stated parameter regime but does not spell out this serialization.

analysis.claim_boundary: These are exact oracle payload formulae. They do not establish an LLM frontier or a practical communication-language advantage.

interpretation_limits: The full-map exchange reveals all private information and uses one simultaneous two-direction batch.
Its simultaneous batch convention differs from the sequential-speaker convention in the cited pointer-chasing lower-bound theorem.
The parity-assisted protocol is a concrete exact construction; do not overstate the source paper's brief observation as describing this exact serialization.
The parity-assisted control is intentionally undefined for k < 3.
All controls omit framing, prompts, tokenizer units, latency, and model inference.

resource_policy.local_work: small deterministic arithmetic and serialization only
